BAY_LANDMARKS.blurb: A path that circles the lake, strung with lamp posts that come on together at dusk.
BAY_LANDMARKS.name: Lakeside Promenade

BAY_LANDMARKS.blurb: A glass-and-steel office tower standing over the downtown core.
BAY_LANDMARKS.name: Skyline Tower

BAY_LANDMARKS.blurb: A marquee-fronted theatre on the uptown strip, still lit for evening shows.
BAY_LANDMARKS.name: The Regal Theatre

BAY_LANDMARKS.blurb: A row of ship-to-shore gantry cranes working the container berths.
BAY_LANDMARKS.name: Harbor Gantry Cranes

BAY_LANDMARKS.blurb: An open plaza where the estuary promenade meets the shops behind it.
BAY_LANDMARKS.name: Waterfront Square

BAY_LANDMARKS.blurb: A toll plaza and viewing turnout where the roadway climbs onto the bridge.
BAY_LANDMARKS.name: Bridge Approach Plaza

BAY_LANDMARKS.blurb: An open-air stadium bowl used for games and other large public events.
BAY_LANDMARKS.name: Civic Stadium

BAY_LANDMARKS.blurb: An indoor arena beside the stadium, host to basketball and other events.
BAY_LANDMARKS.name: Bayside Arena

BAY_LANDMARKS.blurb: An elevated rail platform on concrete piers above the boulevard.
BAY_LANDMARKS.name: Overtown Elevated Station

BAY_LANDMARKS.blurb: A closed street lined with awninged stalls on market days.
BAY_LANDMARKS.name: Market Street Stalls

BAY_LANDMARKS.blurb: A paved turnout in the hills with a bench and a view back over the water.
BAY_LANDMARKS.name: Overlook Point

BAY_LANDMARKS.blurb: A trailhead gate into a stand of tall trees above the city.
BAY_LANDMARKS.name: Redwood Grove Entrance

BAY_LANDMARKS.blurb: A shoreline park with a paved path along the mudflats and marsh grass.
BAY_LANDMARKS.name: Tidewater Shoreline Park

BAY_LANDMARKS.blurb: A ground-level rail depot where freight and passenger tracks meet.
BAY_LANDMARKS.name: Rail Depot

BAY_LANDMARKS.blurb: A two-bay fire station with its apparatus doors facing the street.
BAY_LANDMARKS.name: Fire Station

BAY_LANDMARKS.blurb: A meeting hall used by local trade union locals for dispatch and training.
BAY_LANDMARKS.name: Union Hall

BAY_LANDMARKS.blurb: A community college campus with classroom buildings around a quad.
BAY_LANDMARKS.name: Bay City College

BAY_LANDMARKS.blurb: A community hospital with an emergency entrance and an ambulance bay.
BAY_LANDMARKS.name: Bay General Hospital

BAY_LANDMARKS.blurb: A cluster of brick and steel warehouses along the rail spur.
BAY_LANDMARKS.name: Warehouse District

BAY_LANDMARKS.blurb: A fenced yard for staging, fuelling and inspecting trucks and trailers.
BAY_LANDMARKS.name: Truck Yard

BAY_LANDMARKS.blurb: A small-craft marina with floating docks along the estuary.
BAY_LANDMARKS.name: Estuary Marina

BAY_LANDMARKS.blurb: A clock on a post at the head of the ferry ramp, where passengers wait for the next boat.
BAY_LANDMARKS.name: Ferry Landing Clock

BAY_LANDMARKS.blurb: A paved walk along a sandy beach on the island's open-bay side, with benches facing the water.
BAY_LANDMARKS.name: Island Beach Esplanade

BAY_LANDMARKS.blurb: A long public fishing pier reaching out over the shallows from the marina's breakwater.
BAY_LANDMARKS.name: North Pier

BAY_LANDMARKS.blurb: A covered food hall of small stalls beside the town's main crossing.
BAY_LANDMARKS.name: Emery Public Market

BAY_LANDMARKS.blurb: A shoreline park of lawns and a bay trail between the marina and the treatment plant.
BAY_LANDMARKS.name: South Shoreline Park

BAY_LANDMARKS.blurb: A trail junction on the ridgeline where the path tops out and the whole bay opens up below.
BAY_LANDMARKS.name: Ridge Trail Summit

BAY_LANDMARKS.blurb: A lit navigation buoy marking the edge of the shipping channel into the port.
BAY_LANDMARKS.name: Channel Marker
